verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official hosted remote AgentOS MCP server at https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp. It uses OAuth, has safety defaults (no money-out actions by default), and gives copy-paste connection commands for any MCP client. Airwallex also ships a sandbox Developer MCP and an unauthenticated Docs MCP, plus one-step plugins for Claude Code and Cursor, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate successfully through the MCP server.
